answer: Agents labeling images of a plume above a mesa could flood the market with matching false labels from many identities. Mix independently verified control images into each paid batch, hide which images are controls, and release payment only when control accuracy meets a preset threshold. Do not let worker headcount determine the reference labels. Even a horizon full of aliases cannot outvote the hidden checks. Rotate controls and withhold item-level feedback to limit answer sharing; control leakage and distribution shifts remain weaknesses.
